metadata.description: The Microsoft Sentinel workspace into which the function will be deployed. Has to be in the selected Resource Group.
The region of the selected workspace. The default value will use the Region selection above.

properties.displayName: Authentication ASIM parser for CyberArk Audit
properties.query:
let parser = (disabled: bool = false, pack: bool = false) {
    let EventCodes = datatable(
        auditCode: string
        , EventType: string
        , EventSubType: string
        , _Family: string
        , TargetDvcOs: string
    )[
        'IDP2005', 'Logon', 'Remote', 'Identity', '',
        'IDP2006', 'Logoff', 'Remote', 'Identity', '',
        'IDP2007', 'Logon', 'Remote', 'Identity', '',
        'PAM00007', 'Logon', 'Remote', 'Vault', '',
        'PAM00008', 'Logoff', 'Remote', 'Vault', '',
        'PAM00300', 'Logon', 'RemoteInteractive', 'PSM', '',
        'PAM00301', 'Logon', 'RemoteInteractive', 'PSM', '',
        'PAM00302', 'Logoff', 'RemoteInteractive', 'PSM', '',
        'PAM00303', 'Logoff', 'RemoteInteractive', 'PSM', '',
        'PAM00378', 'Logon', 'RemoteInteractive', 'PSM', '',
        'PAM00379', 'Logon', 'RemoteInteractive', 'PSM', '',
        'PAM00380', 'Logoff', 'RemoteInteractive', 'PSM', '',
        'PAM00381', 'Logoff', 'RemoteInteractive', 'PSM', '',
        'DPAI401', 'Logon', 'RemoteInteractive', 'DPA', 'Windows',
        'DPAI402', 'Logoff', 'RemoteInteractive', 'DPA', 'Windows',
        'DPAE403', 'Logon', 'RemoteInteractive', 'DPA', 'Windows',
        'PSMSTRT', 'Logon', 'RemoteInteractive', 'SSH', 'Linux',
        'PSMTRMN', 'Logoff', 'RemoteInteractive', 'SSH', 'Linux'
    ];
    // Same patterns as the ASIM data tester
    let FqdnRegex = @'^([_a-zA-Z0-9][_a-zA-Z0-9-]{0,62}\.)+[a-zA-Z]{2,63}$';
    let HostnameRegex = @'^[a-zA-Z0-9-]{1,61}$';
    CyberArk_AuditEvents_CL
    | where not(disabled)
    | where auditCode in (
        'IDP2005', 'IDP2006', 'IDP2007'
        , 'PAM00007', 'PAM00008'
        , 'PAM00300', 'PAM00301', 'PAM00302', 'PAM00303'
        , 'PAM00378', 'PAM00379', 'PAM00380', 'PAM00381'
        , 'DPAI401', 'DPAI402', 'DPAE403'
        , 'PSMSTRT', 'PSMTRMN'
    )
    | lookup EventCodes on auditCode
    | extend EventResult = iff(
        auditCode == 'IDP2007' or auditType in ('Failure', 'System Error')
        , 'Failure'
        , 'Success'
    )
    // customData is missing in some workspaces
    | extend _CdJson = parse_json(column_ifexists('customData', ''))
    // customData is either flat JSON or a nested_items name/value array
    | mv-apply _Item = _CdJson.nested_items on (
        summarize _Nested = make_bag(bag_pack(tostring(_Item.name), _Item.value))
    )
    | extend _Cd = iff(isnotempty(_CdJson.nested_items), _Nested, _CdJson)
    | extend
        _LogonDomain = tostring(_Cd.logondomain)
        , _SrcHostnameCd = tostring(_Cd.source_hostname)
    | parse-kv tostring(_Cd.new_target) as (
        ApplicationType: string
        , DstHost: string
        , Protocol: string
        , PSMID: string
        , SessionDuration: string
        , SessionID: string
        , SrcHost: string
    ) with (pair_delimiter=';', kv_delimiter='=')
    | project-rename
        _ApplicationType = ApplicationType
        , _DstHost = DstHost
        , _Protocol = Protocol
        , _PSMID = PSMID
        , _SessionDuration = SessionDuration
        , _SessionID = SessionID
        , _SrcHost = SrcHost
    | extend _TargetUser = case(
        // PSM targetAccount is unqualified; prefix the logon domain
        _Family == 'PSM', iff(
            isnotempty(_LogonDomain) and isnotempty(targetAccount)
                and targetAccount !contains '\\'
                and targetAccount !contains '@'
            , strcat(_LogonDomain, '\\', targetAccount)
            , targetAccount
        )
        , _Family == 'DPA', coalesce(
            tostring(_Cd.ephemeral_user)
            , tostring(split(
                tostring(split(tostring(_Cd.connection_string), ' /u ')[1])
                , ' '
            )[0])
        )
        , _Family == 'SSH', tostring(split(target, '@')[0])
        , username
    )
    | extend _OrigDetails = case(
        _Family == 'Identity', tostring(_Cd.failure_reason)
        , _Family == 'DPA', tostring(_Cd.error_code)
        , _Family == 'SSH', coalesce(
            tostring(_Cd.terminate_error)
            , iff(
                EventResult == 'Failure'
                , tostring(_Cd.terminate_reason)
                , ''
            )
        )
        , iff(EventResult == 'Failure', message, '')
    )
    | extend EventResultDetails = case(
        EventResult == 'Success', ''
        , _OrigDetails in (
            'Challenge not answered or answered incorrectly'
            , 'User missing ability to satisfy challenge(s)'
        ), 'MFA not satisfied'
        , _OrigDetails == 'Auth session was abandoned or expired'
            , 'Session expired'
        , _OrigDetails in (
            'User account locked'
            , 'DPA_RDP_ACCOUNT_LOCKED_OUT_ERROR'
        ), 'User locked'
        , _OrigDetails == 'User password is expired', 'Password expired'
        , _OrigDetails == 'User disabled', 'User disabled'
        , 'Other'
    )
    | extend _SrcAddr = trim(@'\s+', case(
        _Family == 'PSM', _SrcHost
        , _Family == 'Vault', tostring(_Cd.station_ip)
        , source
    ))
    | extend _SrcIsIp = isnotnull(parse_ipv4(_SrcAddr))
        or isnotempty(parse_ipv6(_SrcAddr))
    // DPA reports the source IP and the source hostname separately
    | extend _SrcHostRaw = trim(@'\s+', iff(
        _SrcIsIp or isempty(_SrcAddr)
        , _SrcHostnameCd
        , _SrcAddr
    ))
    | extend
        _SrcIsFqdn = _SrcHostRaw matches regex FqdnRegex
        , _SrcShort = tostring(split(_SrcHostRaw, '.')[0])
    // Malformed host values are left unmapped
    | extend
        SrcIpAddr = iff(_SrcIsIp, _SrcAddr, '')
        , SrcHostname = iff(
            (_SrcIsFqdn or _SrcShort == _SrcHostRaw)
                and _SrcShort matches regex HostnameRegex
            , _SrcShort
            , ''
        )
        , SrcFQDN = iff(_SrcIsFqdn, _SrcHostRaw, '')
        , SrcDomain = iff(
            _SrcIsFqdn
            , substring(_SrcHostRaw, strlen(_SrcShort) + 1)
            , ''
        )
    | extend
        _AuthMethod = tostring(_Cd.authentication_method)
        , _IsSession = _Family in ('PSM', 'DPA', 'SSH')
        , _IsUrl = _DstHost contains '://'
        // uuid is missing in some workspaces
        , EventOriginalUid = column_ifexists('uuid', '')
    | extend _TargetHost = trim(@'\s+', case(
        // Failed PSM sessions may lack DstHost; fall back to the account address
        _Family == 'PSM', coalesce(
            iff(_IsUrl, tostring(parse_url(_DstHost).Host), _DstHost)
            , tostring(_Cd.address)
        )
        , _Family == 'DPA', coalesce(tostring(_Cd.target_machine), target)
        , _Family == 'SSH', tostring(split(
            tostring(split(target, '@')[1])
            , '#'
        )[0])
        , _Family == 'Vault', tostring(_Cd.target)
        , ''
    ))
    | extend _TargetIsIp = isnotnull(parse_ipv4(_TargetHost))
        or isnotempty(parse_ipv6(_TargetHost))
    | extend
        _TargetIsFqdn = not(_TargetIsIp) and _TargetHost matches regex FqdnRegex
        , _TargetShort = iff(
            _TargetIsIp
            , ''
            , tostring(split(_TargetHost, '.')[0])
        )
    // Malformed host values are left unmapped; Dst keeps the original value
    | extend
        TargetIpAddr = iff(_TargetIsIp, _TargetHost, '')
        , TargetHostname = iff(
            (_TargetIsFqdn or _TargetShort == _TargetHost)
                and _TargetShort matches regex HostnameRegex
            , _TargetShort
            , ''
        )
        , TargetFQDN = iff(_TargetIsFqdn, _TargetHost, '')
        , TargetDomain = iff(
            _TargetIsFqdn
            , substring(_TargetHost, strlen(_TargetShort) + 1)
            , ''
        )
    | extend
        TargetUsernameType = case(
            isempty(_TargetUser), ''
            , _TargetUser contains '@', 'UPN'
            , _TargetUser contains '\\', 'Windows'
            , 'Simple'
        )
        , TargetUserId = iff(_Family == 'Identity', userId, '')
        , TargetUserType = case(
            identityType == 'HUMAN', 'Regular'
            , identityType == 'NON_HUMAN', 'Other'
            , ''
        )
        , ActorUsername = iff(_IsSession, username, '')
        , ActorUserId = iff(_IsSession and userId != username, userId, '')
        , TargetUrl = iff(_IsUrl, _DstHost, '')
        , TargetSessionId = case(
            _Family == 'Identity', tostring(_Cd.session_guid)
            , _Family == 'PSM', _SessionID
            , sessionId
        )
        , TargetAppName = iff(_Family in ('Identity', 'Vault'), serviceName, '')
        , ActingAppName = iff(_Family in ('Vault', 'PSM'), source, '')
        , SrcGeoCity = tostring(_Cd.geoip_city_name)
        , SrcGeoCountry = tostring(_Cd.geoip_country_code)
        , SrcGeoLatitude = toreal(_Cd.geoip_latitude)
        , SrcGeoLongitude = toreal(_Cd.geoip_longitude)
        , SrcDvcOs = tostring(_Cd.device_os)
        , SrcDeviceType = iff(
            tostring(_Cd.mobile_device) =~ 'true'
            , 'Mobile Device'
            , ''
        )
        , HttpUserAgent = tostring(_Cd.user_agent)
        , LogonMethod = case(
            _IsSession, 'PAM'
            , _AuthMethod == 'MultiAuth', 'Multi factor authentication'
            , _AuthMethod == 'UserPassword', 'Username & Password'
            , isnotempty(_AuthMethod), 'Other'
            , ''
        )
        , LogonProtocol = case(
            // 'Irrelevant' is a vendor placeholder
            _Family == 'PSM', iff(_Protocol =~ 'Irrelevant', '', _Protocol)
            , _Family == 'DPA', 'RDP'
            , _Family == 'SSH', tostring(_Cd.protocol)
            , ''
        )
        , EventSeverity = iff(EventResult == 'Failure', 'Low', 'Informational')
        , EventMessage = iff(
            isempty(message) or message startswith 'cloud.core.'
            , action
            , message
        )
        , EventCount = int(1)
        // Identity reports the UTC event time in when_occurred
        , EventStartTime = iff(
            _Family == 'Identity'
            , coalesce(todatetime(tostring(_Cd.when_occurred)), TimeGenerated)
            , TimeGenerated
        )
        , EventVendor = 'CyberArk'
        , EventProduct = 'Audit'
        , EventSchema = 'Authentication'
        , EventSchemaVersion = '1.0.0'
        , DvcIdType = iff(isnotempty(CyberArkTenantId), 'Other', '')
        , AdditionalFields = iff(
            pack
            , bag_pack(
                'ServiceName', serviceName
                , 'Component', component
                , 'Safe', safe
                , 'TargetPlatform', targetPlatform
                , 'TargetAccount', targetAccount
                , 'ApplicationType', _ApplicationType
                , 'PsmId', _PSMID
                , 'SessionDuration'
                , coalesce(_SessionDuration, tostring(_Cd.session_duration))
                , 'AccessMethod', tostring(_Cd.access_method)
                , 'AuthenticationMethod'
                , coalesce(_AuthMethod, tostring(_Cd.authentication_methods))
                , 'IdentityProvider', tostring(_Cd.identity_provider)
                , 'DirectoryServiceType', tostring(_Cd.directory_service_type)
                , 'Roles', tostring(_Cd.roles)
                , 'SourceHostname', _SrcHostnameCd
                , 'ErrorDescription', tostring(_Cd.error_description)
            )
            , dynamic({})
        )
    | project-rename
        EventOriginalType = auditCode
        , EventOriginalSubType = actionType
        , EventOriginalSeverity = auditType
        , EventOriginalResultDetails = _OrigDetails
        , TargetUsername = _TargetUser
        , DvcId = CyberArkTenantId
        , DvcDescription = serviceName
        , TargetOriginalUserType = identityType
        , EventUid = _ItemId
    | extend
        EventEndTime = EventStartTime
        , TargetAppType = iff(isnotempty(TargetAppName), 'SaaS application', '')
        , TargetUserIdType = iff(isnotempty(TargetUserId), 'Other', '')
        , ActorUserIdType = iff(isnotempty(ActorUserId), 'Other', '')
        , ActorUsernameType = case(
            isempty(ActorUsername), ''
            , ActorUsername contains '@', 'UPN'
            , ActorUsername contains '\\', 'Windows'
            , 'Simple'
        )
        , TargetDomainType = iff(isnotempty(TargetDomain), 'FQDN', '')
        , SrcDomainType = iff(isnotempty(SrcDomain), 'FQDN', '')
        , Dvc = coalesce(DvcId, 'CyberArk')
        , Src = coalesce(SrcIpAddr, SrcFQDN, SrcHostname)
        , Dst = coalesce(TargetIpAddr, TargetFQDN, TargetHostname, _TargetHost)
        , IpAddr = SrcIpAddr
        , User = TargetUsername
        , Application = TargetAppName
    | project
        TimeGenerated
        , Type
        , EventCount
        , EventStartTime
        , EventEndTime
        , EventType
        , EventSubType
        , EventResult
        , EventResultDetails
        , EventOriginalResultDetails
        , EventOriginalType
        , EventOriginalSubType
        , EventOriginalSeverity
        , EventOriginalUid
        , EventUid
        , EventSeverity
        , EventMessage
        , EventVendor
        , EventProduct
        , EventSchema
        , EventSchemaVersion
        , Dvc
        , DvcId
        , DvcIdType
        , DvcDescription
        , LogonMethod
        , LogonProtocol
        , ActorUsername
        , ActorUsernameType
        , ActorUserId
        , ActorUserIdType
        , ActingAppName
        , TargetUsername
        , TargetUsernameType
        , TargetUserId
        , TargetUserIdType
        , TargetUserType
        , TargetOriginalUserType
        , TargetSessionId
        , TargetAppName
        , TargetAppType
        , TargetHostname
        , TargetFQDN
        , TargetDomain
        , TargetDomainType
        , TargetIpAddr
        , TargetUrl
        , TargetDvcOs
        , SrcIpAddr
        , SrcHostname
        , SrcFQDN
        , SrcDomain
        , SrcDomainType
        , SrcGeoCity
        , SrcGeoCountry
        , SrcGeoLatitude
        , SrcGeoLongitude
        , SrcDvcOs
        , SrcDeviceType
        , HttpUserAgent
        , Src
        , Dst
        , IpAddr
        , User
        , Application
        , AdditionalFields
};
parser(disabled = disabled, pack = pack)
